title: Uruguayan Empanadas Stuffed with Roasted Vegetables
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional Uruguayan empanadas, filled with a flavorful mixture of roasted vegetables. Perfect as a snack or light lunch.
instructions: Brush the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced red bell pepper, yellow onion, and zucchini. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the shredded mozzarella cheese until melted.
Spoon the vegetable mixture into the baked empanadas.
Top with chopped cilantro and serve warm.
